mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in payroll employment growth above 150k signals rising household income and consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline in periods where PAYEMS growth exceeds 150k (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month decline in the Housing Starts Index below 1.2 million units signals weakening residential investment and reduced construction-related earnings, which lowers S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when HOUST falls below 1.2m (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 4-month decline in Real Personal Consumption Expenditures (RSAFS) below $600 billion signals weakening consumer demand, which reduces corporate revenue growth and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when RSAFS falls below $600B (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month contraction in Industrial Production below 101.5 (index 2017=100) signals weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces earnings for industrial firms and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when INDPRO falls below 101.5 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the unemployment rate below 3.5% signals labor market overheating, which increases wage pressure and inflation risk, and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when UNRATE falls below 3.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month decline in GDP growth below 1.5% signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate earnings and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when GDP growth falls below 1.5% (t-test p > 0.05).
